{{Quote|It is like a dejarik board where neither player can see the other... nor all the pieces. It is not a fair game - an equitable game.|[[G0-T0]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />}}
The '''Dark Wars''' ([[3955 BBY|3955]]&ndash;[[3951 BBY]]) were conflicts that stemmed from the defeat of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Darth Malak's Sith Empire]] at the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The [[First Jedi Purge]] and the [[Sith Civil War]] were two of these conflicts.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />

==History==
The Dark Wars began after the defeat of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Malak]]<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" /> on the [[Star Forge]].<ref name="KotOR game">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> After the battle, many [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] took what was left of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Darth Malak's Sith Empire]] and made smaller Sith empires. By [[3954 BBY]], [[Kreia|Darth Traya]], [[Darth Nihilus]], and [[Darth Sion]] had established the [[Sith Triumvirate]] and quickly took control of the many Sith empires, establishing a unified Sith Empire once more. Under the Sith Triumvirate's leadership, the Sith Empire began the [[First Jedi Purge]], killing most of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. In [[3951 BBY]], the Jedi [[Meetra Surik]] killed Darth Nihilus in the [[Battle of Telos IV]]. Later that year, she killed Darth Sion and Darth Traya in the [[Battle of Malachor]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" /> Soon afterwards, what remained of the Sith Empire fell apart. By [[3950 BBY]], the entire Sith Empire had been destroyed and its territory had returned to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />
